regime_read: Convergence favors semiconductors, AI infrastructure and select cybersecurity names, but several signals are sentiment-heavy and the desk has no scored history yet [track_record]. PLTR is the clearest no-chase case because its six-channel convergence coincides with +47.2pp relative strength and an extended flag [retail_buzz] [gov_contract] [extended].
regime_read_zh: 当前信号汇聚偏向半导体、AI基础设施及部分网络安全公司，但若干信号主要由情绪驱动，且本策略尚无已评分历史记录 [track_record]。PLTR是最明确的不追高标的：六渠道汇聚同时伴随相对SPY高出47.2个百分点及延伸过度标记 [retail_buzz] [gov_contract] [extended]。

theses.thesis: AMAT has the cleanest non-extended breadth: four congressional participants are net buyers, analyst and news sentiment are strongly bullish, and 293 patents indicate sustained technical activity [congress_cluster] [analyst_upgrade_cluster] [news_sentiment] [patent_cluster]. Its -29.1pp relative performance leaves room for normalization, although the 1.07 put/call ratio makes options activity equivocal rather than confirming [unusual_options].
theses.thesis_zh: AMAT拥有最清晰且未延伸过度的广度：四名国会议员呈净买入，分析师与新闻情绪明显偏多，293项专利显示技术活动持续 [congress_cluster] [analyst_upgrade_cluster] [news_sentiment] [patent_cluster]。其相对SPY落后29.1个百分点，为均值修复留下空间；但1.07的看跌/看涨比使期权信号偏中性，而非进一步确认 [unusual_options]。
second_order: LRCX/KLAC — semiconductor-equipment peers could benefit if the signal reflects a broader fabrication-investment cycle.
MU — memory-capacity investment would transmit equipment spending into a named memory producer in the pack.
theses.dissent: The severe relative underperformance may reflect a deteriorating equipment cycle, while the slightly bearish options balance does not support an imminent reversal [unusual_options].

falsifier.text: Congressional net buying reverses and analyst or news sentiment turns predominantly bearish while relative performance continues deteriorating.

theses.thesis: NVDA combines unanimous analyst bullishness, large open-source/model demand, 270 patents and disclosed holdings by Nancy Pelosi, Marjorie Taylor Greene and Michael McCaul [analyst_upgrade_cluster] [github_momentum] [patent_cluster] [actor:Nancy Pelosi] [actor:Marjorie Taylor Greene] [actor:Michael McCaul]. Relative strength is only +10.4pp, so the evidence does not indicate a technically extended entry, but heavy retail attention raises crowding risk [retail_buzz].
theses.thesis_zh: NVDA同时具备一致偏多的分析师观点、较强的开源/模型需求、270项专利，以及Nancy Pelosi、Marjorie Taylor Greene和Michael McCaul披露的持仓 [analyst_upgrade_cluster] [github_momentum] [patent_cluster] [actor:Nancy Pelosi] [actor:Marjorie Taylor Greene] [actor:Michael McCaul]。其相对强度仅为+10.4个百分点，证据未显示入场位置已明显延伸，但高零售关注度带来拥挤风险 [retail_buzz]。
second_order: MU — advanced-memory demand is a direct complement to accelerated-computing deployments.
HUT — its documented pivot toward AI power and data-center infrastructure could benefit from continued compute build-out [label_mismatch:HUT].
AI power and cooling infrastructure — greater accelerator deployment increases data-center electrical and thermal requirements.
theses.dissent: Perfect analyst bullishness plus substantial retail attention may represent crowded expectations rather than incremental information [analyst_upgrade_cluster] [retail_buzz].

falsifier.text: Developer momentum and patent activity weaken while analyst sentiment rolls over and NVDA begins materially underperforming SPY.

theses.thesis: CRWD shows alignment across smart-money additions, net buying by two congressional members, an 89% analyst bull ratio and a positive Trump-linked signal [13f_add] [congress_buy] [analyst_upgrade_cluster] [trump]. At +26.8pp versus SPY it is strong but below the desk's extension threshold, leaving a possible entry while limiting conviction because no operating-demand channel is included.
theses.thesis_zh: CRWD在聪明资金增持、两名国会议员净买入、89%的分析师看多比例及正向特朗普关联信号之间形成一致性 [13f_add] [congress_buy] [analyst_upgrade_cluster] [trump]。其相对SPY高出26.8个百分点，走势强劲但尚未达到本策略的延伸阈值，因此仍可能存在入场机会；不过证据包缺少经营需求渠道，故保持低置信度。
second_order: PANW/FTNT — cybersecurity peers could benefit if the buying reflects broader security-budget resilience.
Cloud-security vendors — continued enterprise security spending would support adjacent identity, endpoint and network platforms.
theses.dissent: The convergence is positioning-led and lacks contract, app-demand or product-usage evidence, while relative strength is already elevated.

falsifier.text: Institutional and congressional additions reverse while analyst bullishness falls and relative strength breaks down.

theses.thesis: MU links maximum measured insider purchase intensity, 446 patents and unanimous Stocktwits bullishness with a newly introduced federal assessment of advanced-memory competitiveness [insider_mspr] [patent_cluster] [stocktwits_bull] [bill:HR10170]. Its +1.2pp relative performance is not extended, but earnings in four days create binary event risk, so the convergence is better watched through the report [special_situation].
theses.thesis_zh: MU将最高水平的已测内部人买入强度、446项专利、Stocktwits一致看多，与新提出的先进存储竞争力联邦评估法案联系起来 [insider_mspr] [patent_cluster] [stocktwits_bull] [bill:HR10170]。其相对SPY仅高出1.2个百分点，并未延伸过度；但四天后财报带来二元事件风险，因此更适合等待财报后观察 [special_situation]。
second_order: AMAT — additional leading-edge memory investment would support semiconductor-equipment demand.
NVDA — greater advanced-memory availability supports accelerator-system deployment.
HBM packaging and test suppliers — tighter advanced-memory requirements increase packaging and qualification intensity.
theses.dissent: The policy item only requires a study, retail sentiment is potentially crowded, and the imminent earnings event can overwhelm the slower-moving signals [stocktwits_bull] [bill:HR10170].

falsifier.text: The earnings report shows weakening advanced-memory demand or margins and insider purchase intensity does not persist.

theses.thesis: PLTR has genuine six-channel alignment through accelerating federal contracts, unanimous analyst bullishness, developer momentum and disclosed links to Marjorie Taylor Greene and Cathie Wood [gov_contract] [analyst_upgrade_cluster] [github_momentum] [actor:Marjorie Taylor Greene] [actor:Cathie Wood]. However, +47.2pp relative strength and the explicit extended flag mean the entry is gone; retail and Stocktwits enthusiasm add crowding rather than a reason to chase [retail_buzz] [stocktwits_bull] [extended].
theses.thesis_zh: PLTR通过加速增长的联邦合同、一致偏多的分析师观点、开发者动能，以及与Marjorie Taylor Greene和Cathie Wood的披露关联形成真实的六渠道汇聚 [gov_contract] [analyst_upgrade_cluster] [github_momentum] [actor:Marjorie Taylor Greene] [actor:Cathie Wood]。然而，其相对SPY高出47.2个百分点且被明确标记为延伸过度，当前入场窗口已经消失；零售与Stocktwits热度增加的是拥挤风险，而非追涨理由 [retail_buzz] [stocktwits_bull] [extended]。
second_order: Government IT integrators — faster federal analytics procurement could lift implementation and integration demand.
CRWD — stronger federal technology spending may spill into adjacent cybersecurity procurement.
Cloud infrastructure providers — expanding analytics workloads require additional compute and storage capacity.
theses.dissent: The fundamental contract signal may continue overpowering valuation and crowding concerns, leaving watchers behind despite the extended setup [gov_contract].

falsifier.text: Federal-contract acceleration turns negative and developer momentum fades before the stock works off its extended condition.
